'''Mils Gessak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], locating small [[Planet/Legends|planetoids]] and [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] for use as remote bases and sensor posts. He was the leader of reconnaissance team [[Recon Mission D812|D812]].
